llm.summary: This OCR skill is a coherent remote document-processing integration, but users should treat submitted documents as sensitive data sent to AgentPMT and Google Document AI.

dimensions.detail: Sending user-provided documents to a remote OCR backend is proportionate to the stated purpose, but users should minimize or redact high-sensitivity content where possible.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact has no local runtime, but it documents unpinned npx-based installation commands for related setup skills, which is supply-chain hygiene risk rather than evidence of malicious behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Remote processing is disclosed through AgentPMT-hosted calls and Google Document AI, but the skill should make the privacy implications for sensitive documents more prominent and its generated sample payloads include contradictory placeholder inputs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background worker, persistence mechanism, privilege escalation, local credential harvesting, or automatic mutation behavior was found; the only repeated-install behavior is a freshness recommendation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose, actions, schemas, and examples center on OCR and structured extraction for PDFs/images, including receipts, invoices, IDs, tax forms, and bank statements.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending selected documents to AgentPMT/Google Document AI for OCR. Avoid submitting passports, driver's licenses, tax forms, bank statements, medical records, or contracts unless you are authorized to share them, and prefer redacted/minimized inputs. Use pinned or trusted install sources for the related setup skills when possible.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The skill does handle highly sensitive document classes, but the artifact repeatedly identifies AgentPMT/Google Document AI remote processing; this supports user guidance rather than a Review verdict.
[SQP-1] expected: The activation terms are broad OCR/document terms, but they align with the product's stated purpose and supported action rather than unrelated behavior.
[E1] expected: External transmission to AgentPMT endpoints is real, but it is the core disclosed mechanism of this remote OCR product.
[RP1] unexpected: Unpinned npx examples for related skill installation are a legitimate supply-chain note, but no malicious current dependency or hidden code execution is present in this artifact.
[T08] unexpected: The static scan's unpinned-install concern is accepted as install guidance, not as proof of unsafe behavior in the reviewed skill content.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The all-input sample payloads and non-base64 placeholder conflict with the documented schema, but this appears to be generated documentation inconsistency rather than malicious capability.
